name: Material standard: Lapin
summary: How materials draw in cuts, plans and facades: Lapin's built-in „Lapin” standard as a pack (indicative).
description: Lapin's default look: the cut patterns of common default materials (masonry 45° lines, concrete speckle, blocks crosshatched, insulation, timber grain), drawn by Lapin's own patterns, and facades at the object's real size. One look recognised everywhere, not a country's norm. Indicative: check it against the standard your drawings must follow. Installed, it is added to the open project with „Add to this project” and applied from Manage → Drawing standards → Materials. Country: none (international); norm: none.

items: 30 rules (cut, plan and facade graphics by the material's name)
